events.subtitle: with Operelly
events.factual_description: Union Stage Presents lists POiSON GiRL FRiEND with Operelly at the Howard Theatre in Washington, DC on Thursday, September 10, 2026. The event is all ages, with doors at 7:00 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM, at 620 T Street NW. The presenter links directly to TicketWeb as the authorized ticket destination. Nippon Columbia describes POiSON GiRL FRiEND's music as a blend of ambient techno/trip-hop and French pop and traces her regular DJ work in Roppongi and Shiroganedai to 1990. The label also documents a ten-show North American tour in 2024 and the renewed international attention to her early-1990s work. Apple Music lists Reprises as her latest release, dated August 25, 2026, and lists nearby 2026 shows in Philadelphia, Washington, and New York. No face-value ticket price or additional touring personnel beyond the official billing is recorded because those details were not verified from an accessible authoritative source in this pass.

en.why_it_matters: POiSON GiRL FRiEND arrives in Washington at an interesting second life: the Tokyo club-world hybrid of ambient techno, trip-hop and French pop that she was shaping in the early 1990s is being heard by a new international audience while she is still making new work. The Howard date turns that rediscovery into a local live encounter rather than a reissue-only story.
en.trip_verdict: If Thursday is open, the Howard Theatre is the sensible place to catch this thread locally. There is no need to chase the surrounding Philadelphia or New York dates unless Washington no longer works.
